idea: A top-down puzzle game about walking through doorways you place yourself, taught gently: level 1 has no portal gun (pre-placed portals, the box, a button-gate, the purple goal tile), and every later mechanic debuts in a tiny room before its sandbox. Bolts place portals only on the clicked cell - blocked line of sight animates the bolt to the obstruction and fizzles, never placing elsewhere. SPACE lifts/drops/feeds the box or toggles the gun; pads launch players and parcels alike; doors are switch-gates (often guarding the goal) wired to red buttons weighted by player or box. Eight levels build from walking through one portal to the Grand Tour: keyhole shots, shielded crossings, pocket extractions through both faces of one wall cell, forced elbow flights, ferry discipline, box artillery, and holding a gate open for your own parcel's flight. Levels are data: one JSON file per level.
title: Escape Velocity
